UNDERTAKING/DECLARATION AND AADHAAR CONSENT
            FOR MMNMA / MMNBA, ACADEMIC SESSION 2026-27


I, _____________________________, Enrollment/ARN No. _________________________,
Son/Daughter of ______________________________, resident of ____________________
____________________________________, Course/Class ____________________, do
hereby solemnly declare and undertake the following:


   1. I am applying under: [ ] Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni (MMNMA) [ ] Mukhya
       Mantrir Nijut Babu Aasoni (MMNBA).
   2. I declare that I am a permanent resident of Assam and that I fulfil the eligibility
       conditions applicable to the scheme selected above. My marital status is
       ____________________.
   3. Where applicable, I have not opted for the Dr. Banikanta Kakati Merit Award/Scooter
       Scheme for the relevant academic session.
   4. If applying under MMNBA, I confirm that I was admitted under the Fee Waiver
       Scheme and that my family's annual income is below Rs. 4.00 lakh.
   5. I agree to comply with all applicable terms and conditions of MMNMA/MMNBA.
   6. I possess a valid Aadhaar number and an Aadhaar-seeded bank account. I voluntarily
       consent to verification of my Aadhaar details for processing my application and
       transferring benefits through ABPS to that account.
   7. I understand that if any information furnished by me is found to be false, I shall forfeit
       the benefits and shall be liable for action as applicable.
Date: ___________________________

Place: __________________________

Signature of the Student/Applicant: __________________________

Signature of the Parent/Guardian: __________________________
